title: Game & System Tester
job_description:
Career Growth Opportunities Young & Dynamic Team Friendly and collaborative work culture

Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or related field Prior experience in software testing, QA, system testing, or game testing is an advantage Basic understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and QA processes Familiarity with bug tracking / test management tools (e.g. Jira, TestRail, Bugzilla) Strong attention to detail with excellent problem-solving skills Ability to identify, document, and reproduce bugs clearly and accurately Understanding of functional, regression, usability, compatibility, and performance testing Basic knowledge of web, mobile, or system platforms (Windows / Android / iOS / browser-based systems) Passion for gaming and understanding of gameplay mechanics (for game testing roles) Basic knowledge of SQL, APIs, or automation testing is a plus Good communication skills in English (Mandarin is an advantage if working with China teams) Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment Willingness to handle repetitive testing tasks with patience and consistency Fresh graduates with strong interest in QA / game testing are encouraged to apply (if applicable) Nice to have (optional): Experience with automation tools (e.g. Selenium, Appium) Basic scripting knowledge (Python / JavaScript) Experience testing mobile apps, web platforms, or online games

Test games and systems to identify bugs, glitches, errors, and performance issues Execute manual testing based on test cases and requirements Report, document, and track defects clearly with detailed reproduction steps Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing Test UI/UX, functionality, compatibility, and overall user experience Conduct performance, stability, and basic security testing where required Test across different devices, operating systems, browsers, or platforms Work closely with developers, product teams, and designers to resolve issues Ensure products meet quality standards before release Provide feedback on gameplay experience, usability, and system improvements Assist in creating and updating test plans, test cases, and testing documentation Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) when needed

Benefits Dental Medical Parking Regular hours, Mondays - Fridays, Casual (e.g. T-shirts)

Game Testing Bug Tracking System Testing
